portal_description:
The Common Java Packages Software Collection provides common Java libraries and tools used by other components. The rh-java-common Collection is required by the devtoolset-4, devtoolset-3, rh-maven33, maven30, rh-mongodb32, rh-mongodb26, thermostat1, rh-thermostat16, and rh-eclipse46 Software Collections and it is not supposed to be installed directly by users.

The rh-java-common packages have been updated and extended to comply with the changes in the dependent components. (BZ#1356160)

Users of rh-java-common are advised to upgrade to these updated packages, which fix these bugs and add these enhancements.
